steps.title: Monsoon winds
steps.source_text: In summer the land heats faster than the sea, so moist air is drawn inland from the ocean and brings the rains that most farming depends on.

steps.title: Rivers of the north
steps.source_text: Snowmelt in the mountains feeds rivers that run all year, carrying silt that settles on the plains and makes the soil fertile.

new_chunks.text: In summer the land heats faster than the sea, so moist air is drawn inland from the ocean and brings the rains that most farming depends on. The retreating monsoon of October then turns the winds around, and the east coast takes a second, shorter wet season from them.
Snowmelt in the mountains feeds rivers that run all year, carrying silt that settles on the plains and makes the soil fertile.
